learning_extracted: An acceptance rule C1 AND (C2 OR C3) can pass with the only substantive criterion (C2) false when C1 is structurally inflated and C3 is vacuous; the OR makes a load-bearing criterion bypassable.

z_goal=0 here is precondition_unmet (missing update_z_goal call + agent built without z_goal_enabled), not a substrate ceiling; assert a non-triviality positive control before reading the criterion (the 2026-06-02 Stage-0 forced-feed positive control is exactly this).
C1 'cells complete' must exclude by-construction baseline auto-completions from the survival fraction (3/9 was inflated to 6/12).

A vacuous substrate-readiness PASS that drives a 'prereq cleared' declaration is a governance hazard even when the run is non_contributory; the clear should not have been issued from 621a alone -- it was bounded only because the immediately-queued 603d re-exposed the fault.
